Title: Logging and Telemetry Current State
Content: MemorySmith exposes both application logging and OpenTelemetry instrumentation as first-class runtime configuration. LoggingOptions control console logging, rolling structured JSONL file output, Windows Event Log integration on Windows, request logging, slow-request thresholds, benchmark timing events, metrics windows, metrics sample limits, and admin diagnostics result caps. LoggingObservabilityService powers `/api/diagnostics/logs` and `/api/diagnostics/logs/metrics`, combining structured log search with optional Windows Event Log reads and log-derived latency or error trend metrics. TelemetryOptions control OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics with local-first defaults: instrumentation is enabled, low-cardinality MemorySmith spans and metrics are registered, exporter output is disabled by default, trace sampling defaults to 10 percent, and noisy request paths such as `/health`, `/_blazor`, and static asset routes are excluded. OperationalDiagnosticsService includes the effective Telemetry configuration in the `/api/diagnostics` snapshot so operators can verify the running observability posture without reading local files.
